sections.heading: tyMtlLibMaterial
sections.content: ThetyMtlLibmaterial automatically loads a material from a .mat file, for simple material referencing. Changes to a .mat file will automatically propagate to anytyMtlLibmaterials, when a max file is reloaded, or the “reload” button is pressed in thetyMtlLibUI. ThetyMtlLibfunctionality is similar to that of the built-in XRefMaterial, however loading/referencing materials directly from a .mat can be more convenient than loading/referencing them from an XRef.

sections.heading: tyLibMtl
sections.content:
Filename: the name of the .mat file to load.

Index: the 0-based index of the material in the .mat file to use.

The chosen index will be internally clamped to the range of available materials in the .mat file.
